requirements.quote:
When a master file is used to load a zone, the operation should be
suppressed if any errors are encountered in the master file.
requirements.condition: When a master file is used to load a zone and any errors are encountered in that file.
requirements.error_behavior: The zone-loading operation should be suppressed.
requirements.why_checkable: A master file with an error can be supplied to the loader to observe whether loading is suppressed.

requirements.quote:
Several other validity checks that should be performed in addition to
insuring that the file is syntactically correct:
requirements.condition: When validating a master file used to load a zone.
requirements.required_behavior: The loader should verify that the master file is syntactically correct.
requirements.why_checkable: The master-file validation path can be inspected or exercised with syntax errors to check that syntax is validated.

requirements.quote: 1. All RRs in the file should have the same class.
requirements.condition: When validating a master file used to load a zone.
requirements.required_behavior: The loader should check that all resource records in the file have the same class.
requirements.why_checkable: The classes of parsed records can be compared, and mixed-class master files can exercise the consistency check.

requirements.quote: 2. Exactly one SOA RR should be present at the top of the zone.
requirements.condition: When validating a master file used to load a zone.
requirements.required_behavior: The loader should check that exactly one SOA resource record is present for the zone.
requirements.why_checkable: Master files with zero, one, or multiple SOA records can exercise the SOA cardinality check.

requirements.quote: 2. Exactly one SOA RR should be present at the top of the zone.
requirements.condition: When validating a master file used to load a zone.
requirements.required_behavior: The loader should check that the SOA resource record is at the top of the zone.
requirements.why_checkable: The SOA owner name can be compared with the zone apex to check its placement.

requirements.quote:
3. If delegations are present and glue information is required,
      it should be present.
requirements.condition: When a master file used to load a zone contains delegations and glue information is required.
requirements.required_behavior: The loader should check that the required glue information is present.
requirements.why_checkable: The validity-check logic can be inspected for checks of glue presence for delegations requiring glue.

requirements.quote:
4. Information present outside of the authoritative nodes in the
      zone should be glue information, rather than the result of an
      origin or similar error.
requirements.condition: When information in a master file is outside the authoritative nodes in the zone.
requirements.required_behavior: The loader should check that this information is glue information rather than information introduced by an origin or similar error.
requirements.why_checkable: Records outside the authoritative nodes can be inspected to determine whether validation checks that they serve as glue.
